description: content/agentware/course/data/manifest.json: one entry per data file, written by tools/course-data/generate.py and never edited by hand. Not served in dist.

agentware.description: The Agentware SDK version installed when the file was generated, or null for a file that does not depend on the SDK. A non-null value makes the file SDK-derived.

generator.description: The generator and its version, for example "generate.py 0.1.0".

source_sha256.description: sha256 over the generator inputs (scripts, sources, lock file) that produced the file. The generator compares it to find stale files.
